title: Phase 8: Observability + self-test
description: GET /admin/egress + startup egress log, prometheus metrics, ServiceMonitor, PrometheusRule (promtool passes), canary Deployment.

title: Decision: Webshare proxy default vs fallback
description: Given household-IP collateral risk, decide if YTT_PROXY_URL is default (protect home IP) or fallback-only. Blocks Phase 10.

title: Phase 5: AuthN/AuthZ + rate limiting (ADR-001)
description: FastMCP OAuth audience-bound to https mcp.ardenone.com /ytt, DCR off, subject allowlist 403, token bucket + Whisper quota 429. Spike FastMCP metadata first. Exit: authz/ratelimit/metadata/wrong-audience tests.

title: Decision: per-subject vs global cache/rate-limit scoping
description: Scope cache keys + rate limits per OAuth subject or global. Affects Phase 4/5.

title: Phase 4: Cache - flat units, LRU, reconcile, ENOSPC
description: Flat (video_id,lang) units txt+json, whole-unit LRU under one lock, byte-cap invariant, reconcile interval, ENOSPC degrade, startup scan + tmp clean, statvfs validation. Exit: invariant-under-concurrency unit tests.

title: Phase 7: Response shape - pagination/cursor/slicing
description: chunk pagination (char offset, content-hash cursor, cursor_stale, loud PARTIAL, structuredContent), start/end/query slicing, get_transcript_job returns transcript when done. ADR-002 chunk-only.

title: Phase 1: Async MCP skeleton + URL canonicalizer + config
description: Async Streamable HTTP (uvicorn 1 worker), tool stubs, URL to canonical video_id (reject playlist/channel/search), pydantic-settings config + startup validations. Exit: tools/list ok; canonicalizer+idempotence unit tests green.

title: Spike: confirm whisper-openai model via /v1/models + calibrate RT_FACTOR
description: YTT_WHISPER_MODEL must be HF repo id pre-pulled on shared service; query /v1/models in-pod; calibrate REALTIME_FACTOR vs live CPU model; reconcile timeout/duration. Blocks Phase 6.

title: Phase 10: Deploy to ardenone-cluster (human-gated ops)
description: Manifests in declarative-config k8s/ardenone-cluster/ytt/ (clone ibkr-mcp); ADDITIVE .well-known routing (ibkr untouched); ibkr before/after regression gate; human ops: OpenBao secrets, optional WAF; add connector on desktop + verify mobile (sc13) + isolation (sc14).

title: Phase 11: Public release - GHCR public + docs + first tag
description: Set GHCR package public+linked, finalize README quick-start + docs/usage/* + LICENSE/CONTRIBUTING/SECURITY/CHANGELOG, first semver tag. Release gate: README quick-start runs against published image with no ardenone specifics.

title: Spike: confirm ardenone-cluster storage class (longhorn) name
description: Confirm Longhorn StorageClass name for the ytt PVC manifest. Blocks Phase 4 manifest / Phase 10.

title: Phase 3: Concurrency - fetch pool, bounded queue, single-flight
description: asyncio.to_thread, Semaphore(MAX_CONCURRENT_FETCHES), bounded queue to 429, per-video single-flight (caption discovery) + failed-Future cleanup. Exit: dedup + 429 unit tests.

title: Phase 9: In-cluster integration test harness
description: ytt test --integration in ardenone-cluster (datacenter-blocked elsewhere), wire unit suite into Argo CI, prove scenarios 1-6,8,11,12,14 + load test (ClusterIP-scoped) + ibkr smoke.

title: Phase 2: Fetch core - yt-dlp json3 + metadata + error taxonomy
description: extract_info captions (player_client tv/web_embedded/mweb), json3 parse WITH ROLLING DEDUP, metadata, language selection, error_code taxonomy + seed strings. Exit: parse/dedup/taxonomy unit tests incl rolling fixture asserts no doubling.

title: Genesis: ytt (YouTube Transcript MCP) Implementation
description: Root tracking bead. Tied to plan: docs/plan/plan.md. Phase beads 0-11 block this; spikes/decisions gate their phases. Closes when all phases complete.

comments.author: cli
comments.text: Progress / phase map (tied to docs/plan/plan.md). Phase chain (each blocks the next, all block this genesis): P0 ytt-5m5 scaffold+CI | P1 ytt-3ld skeleton+canonicalizer | P2 ytt-5c8 fetch core+json3 dedup | P3 ytt-4th concurrency | P4 ytt-2c4 cache | P5 ytt-219 auth/authz | P6 ytt-5rr whisper | P7 ytt-30a response shape | P8 ytt-1ed observability | P9 ytt-5c4 integration tests | P10 ytt-40t deploy (BLOCKED human-gated) | P11 ytt-4iv public release. Gating spikes: json3 dedup ytt-7oe (blocks P2), FastMCP metadata ytt-7dk (blocks P5), whisper model+RT ytt-3te (blocks P6), longhorn class ytt-4rl (blocks P4). Decisions: Webshare default ytt-1rm (blocks P10), image pull source ytt-5m4 (blocks P0), identity scoping ytt-28b (affects P4). ibkr do-no-harm gate ytt-u9o (BLOCKED, blocks P10). Start work: the 7 spikes/decisions are the only unblocked beads.

title: Decision: cluster image pull source - GHCR-only vs dual-push Docker Hub
description: GHCR-only public pull (no secret, diverges from Docker Hub convention) vs dual-push ronaldraygun/ytt. Blocks Phase 0 build config.

title: Phase 0: Project scaffold + CI build pipeline
description: pyproject + uv.lock (pinned py3.12 + fastmcp, yt-dlp, uvicorn, httpx, pydantic-settings, prometheus-client, structlog); ytt package skeleton; Dockerfile (multi-stage, ffmpeg, pytest test stage, CMD ytt serve). Cross-repo declarative-config: ytt-build WorkflowTemplate + ytt-sensor (build and push to GHCR with unit tests); first image build. Plan: Deliverables + CI.

title: Phase 6: Whisper async fallback (whisper-openai)
description: Integrate whisper-openai.whisper-stt.svc 8000 /v1/audio/transcriptions, WhisperJob FSM get-or-create + ETA + TTL GC, scratch vol + startup sweep, timeout, too_long_for_asr, whisper cache namespace. Spike model+RT_FACTOR. Exit: FSM/sweep/model-guard tests.

title: Spike: FastMCP path-inserted + path-bearing OAuth metadata
description: Confirm FastMCP can emit resource/issuer = .../ytt at path-inserted /.well-known/oauth-*/ytt; else custom Starlette routes. Blocks Phase 5.

title: Spike (CRITICAL): json3 rolling-caption dedup
description: Auto-caption asr tracks re-emit prior words; naive join doubles text + poisons cache (yt-dlp 6274/1734). Implement overlap/prefix dedup; mandatory rolling+manual fixtures. Blocks Phase 2.

title: ibkr do-no-harm gate (additive routing + before/after regression)
description: Hard constraint: ytt deploy/tests must not change/degrade ibkr-mcp. Additive higher-priority .well-known rules (no ibkr manifest edit); ClusterIP-scoped load tests; ibkr .well-known + basic call byte-identical before/after. Blocks Phase 10.
